# Sobha Hennur: Full Information

> Sobha Hennur is a pre-launch Sobha (Sobha Limited) township in the Hennur Road corridor of North-East Bengaluru, across Kannur and Chikkagubbi villages, Bidarahalli Hobli: 4,463 homes in 13 towers of up to 42 floors on about 50.45 acres, in nine home types (1 BHK Serviced Apartment, 1 BHK, 2 BHK Luxe, 2 BHK Grande, 2 BHK + Home Office, 3 BHK Luxe, 3 BHK Grande, 4 BHK Luxe and 4 BHK Grande), with offices, service apartments, shops and restaurants, a clubhouse, an amenity block and about 37% green cover. The indicative price is about ₹1.86 Cr for about 1,940 sq ft.

## Amenities

Everyday life is planned in. Beyond a clubhouse and an amenity block, Sobha Hennur sets aside space for learning, health, banking, post and communication, recreation and business, so study, a check-up or a meeting can happen close to home, with parks and landscaped open spaces between the towers and a commercial precinct of shops and restaurants.

- Clubhouse
- Amenity block
- Learning spaces
- Health and first-aid room
- Banking service point
- Resident help desk and parcels
- Indoor games
- Business and meeting rooms
- Parks and open spaces
- Landscaped gardens
- Shops and restaurants
- Civic amenities

## Built to last

**Water**

- On-site sewage treatment (activated sludge process)
- Dual plumbing
- Treated water reused on site
- Rainwater harvesting

**Green**

- About 37% green cover
- A tree-planting programme
- Parks and landscaped open spaces

**Township**

- Offices, service apartments, shops and restaurants
- 5,029 parking spaces
- Civic amenity land

Planned in from the start, across the whole township.

## Location

Sobha Hennur sits in the Hennur Road corridor of North-East Bengaluru, across Kannur and Chikkagubbi villages. Daily life is close: Bhartiya City is about 3.4 km away, Kristu Jayanti University about 4.9 km and VIBGYOR High School Hennur about 6.1 km, while Manyata Tech Park is about 9 km and Kempegowda International Airport about 20.9 km. Distances are approximate driving distances; open the map for directions and live travel times.

## Notes for accuracy

- The indicative price is about ₹1.86 Cr for about 1,940 sq ft; prices for each home type are on request and will be announced at launch.
- The project is in the Hennur Road corridor, not on Hennur Road itself.
- The floor plan images are indicative layouts.
- Distances are approximate driving distances.
- This website is operated by a channel partner and is not the official website of Sobha Limited, whose website is https://www.sobha.com.

## Questions buyers ask

### What is Sobha Hennur?

Sobha Hennur is an upcoming Sobha township in the Hennur Road corridor of North-East Bengaluru: 4,463 homes in nine home types, from serviced 1 BHK apartments to 4 BHK residences, in 13 towers on about 50.45 acres, with offices, shops and restaurants within. It is in pre-launch, so register now for priority access.

### Is Sobha Hennur on Hennur Road?

It is in the Hennur Road residential corridor, across Kannur and Chikkagubbi villages in Bidarahalli Hobli, Bengaluru East, rather than on the road itself. Bhartiya City is about 3.4 km away and Kristu Jayanti University about 4.9 km.

### Which home types can I choose from?

Nine: 1 BHK Serviced Apartment (100 homes), 1 BHK (301), 2 BHK Luxe (318), 2 BHK Grande (310), 2 BHK + Home Office (310), 3 BHK Luxe (1,428), 3 BHK Grande (1,298), 4 BHK Luxe with three bathrooms (166) and 4 BHK Grande with four bathrooms (166).

### How much does a home at Sobha Hennur cost?

The indicative price is about ₹1.86 Cr for about 1,940 sq ft, with stamp duty and registration extra. Prices for each home type will be announced at launch; register your interest to receive the price list first.

### How far is it from Manyata Tech Park and the airport?

Manyata Tech Park is about 9 km away and Kempegowda International Airport, Terminal 1, about 20.9 km. Thanisandra Railway Station is about 6.5 km away and Yelahanka Junction about 9.6 km.

### What will the township include?

A clubhouse and an amenity block; space for learning, health, banking, post and communication, recreation and business; offices, service apartments, shops and restaurants; and parks and landscaped open spaces across about 37% of the land.

### Why choose a Sobha home?

Sobha Limited, founded in 1995 by PNC Menon, builds end to end with its own contracting and manufacturing, from interiors to glazing, metal works and concrete products, a philosophy of self-reliance behind its quality and craftsmanship. It builds in 14 cities across India; its Bengaluru homes include SOBHA Neopolis, SOBHA Townpark and SOBHA OneWorld.
